Feature: Floating point drift prevention
description: Implement GEO-016: Repeated tiny transforms (resize/rotate) should not accumulate significant floating point error. Tests: 1000 tiny rotations should equal ~360 degrees, tiny scales should not drift, bounded drift test with epsilon comparison.

title: Feature: AABB includes stroke width
description: Implement GEO-003: Axis-aligned bounding box calculation should include stroke width / hit margin. Tests: Rectangle with 2px stroke, shapes at various positions, hit margin inclusion, bounds expansion factor.

title: Feature: Hit test margin respects zoom level
description: Implement GEO-020: Hit test margin should either be constant screen-space or constant world-space depending on spec. Tests: Hit test at min zoom, hit test at max zoom, verify margin behavior matches spec (screen-space vs world-space).

title: Feature: Selection bounding box for locked/hidden and container bounds stability
description: Implement GEO-024/025/026: Selection bounding box should exclude locked/hidden elements. Container bounds computed from children should remain stable as children move. Nested container bounds should reflect descendant movement. Tests: Multi-select with locked items, container bounds drift test.

title: Feature: Frontend integration for ExtendedText RTL and emoji support
description: Implement GEO-006 frontend integration: The ExtendedText struct in geometry supports RTL, emoji, ZWJ sequences. Connect frontend text rendering to use ExtendedText for proper text bounds with RTL, emoji, and zero-width joiners. Tests: Verify text boxes render correctly with Arabic, emoji, mixed content.
